notes.title: SEEING THING launch + v1.10 update
notes.content:
It's SEEING THINGS launch day! ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː It's been a whole lot of fun seeing players and streamers play, and love, the game. For some recent streamer action, check out adoption on Twitch over the last couple days https://www.twitch.tv/directory/category/seeing-things/videos/all

notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility for SEEING THINGS
notes.content:
SEEING THINGS has been tested, played, and loved on the Steam Deck! You are now able to play with a mouse and keyboard, a controller, or on a Steam Deck ːsteamhappyː 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710106/98bdc5774f4924e4806dbe8ee46ddfa16a762722.jpg[/img]

We've mapped the following default config profile for Steam Deck: 

- Left and right bumpers: change rooms
- Left and right trackpads: drive the mouse around (it’s cool!)
- Left and right trackpad click: click
- L2 / R2: click
- Two options button: Pause

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710106/1289e083c11744c2dc9533c9a0c12469bccd7c2d.jpg[/img]

Enjoy!

tags.feature: You are now able to play with a mouse and keyboard, a controller, or on a Steam Deck ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Demo v.04 out now! Normal mode unlocked from the get go & more
notes.content:
A new version of the Seeing Things demo is live now. v.04 contains:
- normal mode in the museum is now unlocked from the start
- improved full-screen effects skill test
- added wishlist request on quit
- changed classifications for a couple anomalies
- general fixes and tweaks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710106/5f49d21f75958b64c13a31bb9a6c4891de251224.png[/img]

If you haven't already done so, please wishlist Seeing Things. Thanks for playing and the interest!

tags.feature: - normal mode in the museum is now unlocked from the start

tags.balance_change: - changed classifications for a couple anomalies
